excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的搜索未能在[From.GetName]星系发现风信子号的迹象。也许我们应该到别的星系碰碰运气。
excerpt.en: Scans from the [Root.GetName] have revealed no traces of the Hyacinth in the [From.GetName] system. Perhaps we will have better luck in one of the other systems.
